path_overlap_policy.integration_rule: Each package consumes only an accepted predecessor contract. Later activation or main integration is outside these packages and requires separate authority.

packages.name: Pre-payment Safety UX and payment gate
exact_responsibility: Collect an application-owned structured contact-boundary answer before purchase eligibility.

Define one server-owned purchase state machine that cannot enter a payment-capable state before Safety eligibility.
Keep payment unavailable when no payment implementation exists.
Provide an actual review screen and state-machine evidence for Human visual/Product review.

use free-text case IDs or Provider inference for the structured boundary gate
